description: Allowlist of BACKWARD divergences (registry `latest` ahead of the package's default-branch version — the dangerous T9/T11 pattern where the registry knows about a version the branch's source doesn't reflect) that are already investigated and accepted. generate-register.mjs fails CI only on a backward divergence that is NOT listed here, or on a listed one whose registryLatest no longer matches (the drift moved and needs re-investigation). Forward divergence (branch ahead of registry — ordinary unreleased work) and an unpublished package (no registry versions yet) are never failures and need no entry here. Do not add an entry here to silence a NEW finding — that defeats V3.1 ('zero unexplained divergences'). Only the orchestrator adds an entry, after the drift has been investigated the way T9 (adapter-kit) and T11 (knowledge) were.

entries.reason: T11 finding (Milestone 2 retrospective, 2026-09-23): three-version drift from an org-wide history-squashing event; one of the three drifted versions (0.2.0 or 0.3.0's true source) is genuinely unrecoverable. Investigated and accepted as KNOWN; a full reconciliation to 0.4.0 is out of scope for T12 and not yet scheduled.
